findings.message: Mutable default argument `items: list[Item] = []` makes the same list object shared across all calls that omit `items`, so items accumulate and leak between independent invocations (and returned lists alias each other).
findings.suggestion: Use `items: list[Item] | None = None` and inside the function do `if items is None: items = []` before appending, or use a fresh list per call.
